title: Desenvolvedor(a) Mobile Android Sênior
description:
Perfil do Candidato

Profissional com sólida experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações Mobile Android, com domínio comprovado das principais tecnologias e frameworks da plataforma. Buscamos um candidato que atue de forma autônoma e estratégica, com foco na criação de soluções escaláveis, robustas e de alta qualidade. O profissional deverá ter experiência em liderar iniciativas e orientar equipes, contribuindo para o aprimoramento contínuo das práticas de desenvolvimento.

Senioridade

Sênior:

Profissional com ampla experiência em desenvolvimento Mobile Android, capaz de liderar projetos, definir padrões técnicos e orientar equipes. Deverá demonstrar conhecimento aprofundado em arquitetura de sistemas, testes automatizados e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderança Técnica:Liderar a análise e desenvolvimento de sistemas Mobile Android, definindo estratégias e padrões técnicos.
  • Realizar revisões de código e mentorias para desenvolvedores juniores.
  • Desenvolvimento de Soluções:Projetar, desenvolver e implementar soluções mobile escaláveis e seguras.
  • Criar testes automatizados para garantir a robustez do código.
  • Integração e Colaboração:Colaborar com equipes interfuncionais para definir e entregar novos recursos e melhorias.
  • Gerenciar o build, a configuração e o deploy das aplicações nos diferentes ambientes.
  • Inovação e Melhoria Contínua:Pesquisar, avaliar e implementar novas tecnologias que otimizem os processos de desenvolvimento.
  • Acompanhar a implantação em produção, garantindo a estabilidade e o desempenho dos aplicativos.

Requisitos Técnicos

  • Linguagens e Ferramentas:Domínio avançado em Java e/ou Kotlin.
  • Componentes Android:Sólida experiência com Activities, Fragments, Views e Layouts.
  • Persistência de Dados:Proficiência no uso de SharedPreferences, Room ou SQLite.
  • Consumo de APIs:Experiência robusta com APIs JSON/REST.
  • Build e Deploy:Conhecimento avançado em Gradle (incluindo Build Variants e Tasks) e experiência comprovada em deploy na Play Store.
  • Controle de Versão:Proficiência avançada em Git Flow.
  • Arquiteturas Mobile:Expertise em padrões como MVC, MVP e MVVM.
  • Boas Práticas:Domínio dos princípios SOLID, design de arquitetura mobile e testes automatizados.
  • Planejamento Técnico:Capacidade de propor e implementar soluções técnicas alinhadas às necessidades do projeto.

title: Analista fiscal e contábil sênior
description:
Missão do Cargo:

Responsável por executar, revisar e garantir a conciliação entre lançamentos financeiros e contábeis, com foco em bases nacionais e internacionais; e revisar lançamentos de períodos anteriores, de maneira a garantir relatórios mensais e anuais acurados. Será responsável por todas as atividades fiscais e tributárias da empresa.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar cálculo e elaborar guia dos tributos da empresa;
  • Executar, revisar e garantir a conciliação entre lançamentos financeiros e contábeis;
  • Realizar análises de contas contábeis;
  • Investigar e tratar quebras de conciliação e inconsistências entre financeiro e contábil;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com áreas envolvidas no processo de fechamento contábil mensal;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de rotinas mais robustas de controle;
  • Atuar como facilitador entre a operação financeira e a contabilidade, com foco em acuracidade de informações;
  • Contribuir ativamente na melhoria de processos, controles e documentação;
  • Garantir que os lançamentos intercompany sejam realizados de forma correta;
  • Treinar equipe financeira e contábil sobre a correta utilização do sistema SAP;
  • Ajustar conciliação contábil de meses anteriores.
  • Entrega de obrigações assessórias.
  • Apurar impostos indiretos como ICMS, ICMS ST, DIFAL, IPI, PIS e COFINS;
  • Assessorar outras áreas da companhia em temas tributários;
  • Apurar impostos retidos como ISS, INSS, CSRF e IRRF;
  • Realizar a entrega de declarações acessórias como SPED Fiscal e EFD Contribuições;

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Ensino superior completo em Ciência Contábeis.

Ferramentas & Sistemas:

  • Obrigatório ter conhecimento avançado em Pacote Office;
  • Obrigatório ter conhecimento avançado em SAP B1.

Experiência:

  • Experiência com lançamentos intercompany e multimoedas;
  • Experiência em legislação fiscal e contábil;
  • Sólido conhecimento de legislação fiscal e tributária;
  • Conhecimento em USGAAP e IFRS;
  • Experiência no segmento de comércio exterior.

title: Desenvolvedor Frontend React/TypeScript - Pleno
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Frontend especializado em React e TypeScript para atuar

na concepção e construção de interfaces modernas e responsivas. O profissional participará

ativamente da definição visual e de usabilidade junto ao time (co-criação de layouts),

transformando essas ideias em código de alta qualidade, priorizando a criação de componentes

reutilizáveis e uma arquitetura de frontend escalável, garantindo uma excelente experiência de uso

integrada ao nosso backend.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento de Interfaces: Criar SPAs (Single Page Applications) dinâmicas

utilizando React e TypeScript, com forte tipagem e segurança de código.

  • Componentização e UI: Construção de componentes reutilizáveis.
  • Gerenciamento de Formulários: Implementar formulários complexos e performáticos

utilizando React Hook Forms, integrados com Zod para validação robusta de esquemas de

dados.

  • Integração com Backend: Realizar o consumo de APIs RESTful de forma eficiente

utilizando Axios, tratando estados de carregamento, erros e cache de dados.

  • Navegação e Rotas: Gerenciar o fluxo de navegação da aplicação e proteção de rotas

utilizando React Router.

Requisitos do Cargo:

  • Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de

Informação ou experiência equivalente.

  • Linguagem: Conhecimento médio/avançado em TypeScript e JavaScript.
  • Framework/Lib: Conhecimento em React (Hooks, Context API, Custom Hooks).
  • Ferramentas: Experiência com gerenciamento de formulários (React Hook Form) e

validação (Zod).

  • Integração com APIs: Experiência com Axios para consumo de APIs REST.
  • Navegação: Uso de React Router para gerenciamento de rotas e navegação da aplicação.

Competências Desejáveis (Diferenciais):

  • Conhecimento em otimização de performance (Memoização, Lazy Loading, Code Splitting).
  • Entendimento de gerenciamento de estado global (Context API).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de build (Vite).
  • Conhecimento em bibliotecas de componentes (especificamente PrimeReact ou similares

como Material UI/AntD).

  • Habilidade na criação de protótipos utilizando Figma, com abertura para o uso de ferramentas

de IA para agilizar a concepção visual.

  • Noções de UX/UI para propor melhorias na usabilidade das telas.
  • Capacidade analítica para identificar, diagnosticar e solucionar problemas.

title: Arquiteto (a) Storage - Híbrido
description:
Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

STORAGE JOB DESCRIPTION:

  • Advanced English
  • Good Knowledge on components and architectures.
  • In depth understanding of the HPE Alletra, HP 3PAR, Nimble.
  • Hands on experience with storage array migrations.
  • Experience in SAN storage backup and recovery and exposure to SAN Data replication tools.
  • Experience on Cisco and Brocade fabric switch/Directors. Configuring new switch, upgrades, zoning, VSAN and troubleshooting.
  • Experience of SAN allocation, deallocation.
  • Good Knowledge on RAID concepts, inline data deduplication, inline data compression.
  • Dynamic LUN Provisioning, Zoning, storage firmware upgrades
  • Allocating Boot luns in VMware environment
  • Troubleshooting storage related and compatibility related issues.
  • Allocating LUNs to different operating systems like MS Windows, VMWare ESX/ESXi, Linux and Solaris/AIX/HPUX.
  • Exposure to performance tuning techniques for SAN and NAS
  • Experience in handling major incident bridges, critical issues.
  • Good in scripting and automating the standard storage procedures.
  • Should be familiar with ITIL processes.

Roles & Responsibilities – Storage (HPE 3PAR / Alletra)

1. Design, architect, and deploy HPE 3PAR and Alletra storage solutions based on customer business, performance, and availability requirements.

2. Lead technical discussions with customers and internal stakeholders to understand workload needs and propose optimal storage designs.

3. Manage 3PAR/Alletra arrays including CPGs, virtual volumes, VLUNs, host sets, and port configurations.

4. Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis (RCA) for complex storage, SAN, and performance issues.

5. Plan and execute storage migrations using Peer Motion, Online Import, and host-based migration tools with minimal downtime.

6. Administer and troubleshoot SAN fabrics (Brocade/Cisco) including zoning, ISLs, firmware upgrades, and fabric resiliency.

7. Optimize storage performance and efficiency through RAID selection, tiering, chunklet layout, and adaptive optimization.

8. Implement and manage replication and DR solutions such as Remote Copy, Peer Persistence, and metro cluster configurations.

9. Integrate storage with virtualization and OS platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, Linux, Windows) and resolve multipathing issues.

10. Manage firmware, OS, and controller upgrades ensuring non-disruptive operations and rollback readiness.

11. Leverage HPE InfoSight and SSMC for proactive monitoring, capacity forecasting, and health analysis.

12. Coordinate with backup teams and customers to integrate storage with Commvault / NetBackup for application-consistent backups.

13. Prepare and deliver technical presentations to customers on storage architecture, performance analysis, and solution proposals.

14. Provide regular operational and executive-level reports covering capacity utilization, performance trends, risks, and recommendations.

15. Act as escalation point for critical production incidents and major outages.

16. Collaborate with application, database, network, and virtualization teams to align storage design with end-to-end solutions.

17. Ensure security, compliance, and governance through encryption, RBAC, audit logging, and best-practice controls.

18. Automate and standardize storage operations using CLI, REST APIs, and scripting to improve efficiency and reliability.

19. Mentor L1/L2 engineers and review change requests, SOPs, and implementation plans.

20. Participate in CAB meetings, customer reviews, and vendor engagements (HPE) while supporting 24×7 mission-critical environments.

description:
Sobre a vaga

Código da vaga: 57543

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

  • Ei #fera, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

Principais responsabilidades

  • Definir, implementar e evoluir processos, políticas, papéis e responsabilidades de Governança de Dados, alinhados ao DMBOK (DAMA)
  • Atuar nas frentes de Qualidade de Dados, Segurança e Acesso, Metadados e MDM (Master Data Management)
  • Desenhar e manter Arquiteturas de Dados e de Ambiente Analítico, incluindo estratégias de ingestão e integração de dados.
  • Definir padrões de nomenclatura, catalogação, linhagem e metadados em plataformas de dados.
  • Criar e acompanhar KPIs e indicadores de qualidade, segurança e maturidade de dados.
  • Liderar e apoiar PoCs de ferramentas de Governança, Qualidade de Dados, Metadados e MDM.
  • Atuar no levantamento de requisitos junto às áreas de negócio e stakeholders
  • Apoiar iniciativas de BI Self-Service e modernização de ambientes analíticos.
  • Orientar e mentorar equipes técnicas, disseminando boas práticas de arquitetura, integração e governança de dados.
  • Contribuir para a definição de arquiteturas de referência, garantindo aderência dos projetos aos padrões definidos.

Requisitos técnicos

  • Sólida experiência em Governança de Dados, Arquitetura de Dados e Business Intelligence
  • Forte conhecimento em modelagem de dados
  • Experiência com Qualidade de Dados, Metadados, MDM e Segurança da Informação aplicada a dados
  • Atuação em ambientes analíticos corporativos de médio e grande porte
  • Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem, especialmente Fabric, Purview Conhecimento em estratégias de integração e ingestão de dados
  • Experiência com metodologias Ágeis e Cascata
  • Noções de SQL e Python
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas de negócio

Modelo de atuação

  • Vaga híbrida em São Paulo, 3x presenciais na semana.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Special Projects and Strategy Manager
description:
About Vammo

Vammo is building an accessible, resilient, and scalable clean energy network for emerging megacities, starting in Latin America. By combining electric motorcycle subscriptions with a rapidly expanding battery swap infrastructure, we make clean transportation affordable and reliable for the millions who keep cities moving.

Founded in 2022 and headquartered in São Paulo, Vammo has raised $100M from top-tier investors across the globe. Our founders and team represent an incredibly diverse and international group that is built of former executives coming from Tesla, Uber, Rappi, iFood, Loggi, Niu, Jump and others. We are all deeply motivated by the mission to decarbonize Latin America while simultaneously reducing costs for one of the region's most vulnerable populations.

The next wave of mobility innovation will come not from San Francisco, but from São Paulo. Our operations will soon expand from Sao Paulo to cities across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia, proving that real climate impact and transformative business models can be built first where the need is greatest.

About the Role

Vammo is hiring a strategic, high-performing leader to join our Special Projects & Strategy team - a small, elite group working directly with executives and founders - to solve the most complex and high-impact challenges in the company.

You will lead high-impact initiatives that directly influence Vammo's operational and financial performance, from fleet utilization optimization to spare parts cost reduction. This is a cross-functional role that requires partnering with Operations, Maintenance, Product, Hardware, and Finance to design solutions and drive implementation.

This role combines deep analytical thinking with hands-on execution to drive operational excellence, optimize costs, and ensure accountability across our asset portfolio.

This is a role for someone who thrives on ambiguity, loves tackling hard problems, and moves seamlessly between data, strategy, and execution. You will be deeply embedded across teams - working hand-in-hand with Fleet, Charging, Maintenance, Sales, Software, and Hardware - and expected to think like an owner.

You will be based in São Paulo and will report directly to executives at Vammo

Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute high-impact strategic projects that directly influence Vammo's operational and financial performance, with a focus on asset utilization, custody, and operational excellence.
  • Partner with functional leaders to identify bottlenecks, design solutions, and drive implementation.
  • Build analytical frameworks and dashboards to inform decision-making across the company, including asset utilization metrics, custody tracking, cost analysis, and operational performance.
  • Develop business cases, models, and strategic plans for new initiatives.
  • Own key cross-functional workstreams including asset custody and utilization (battery and box custody), spare parts cost optimization, logistics and distribution, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Translate insights into clear recommendations and operational action — bridge the gap between analysis and execution, ensuring strategic insights drive real-world results.
  • Work closely with the founders and leadership team on board materials and strategic communications.
  • Build and mentor small, high-performing project teams as the function scales, including analysts and specialists focused on logistics, cost optimization, and asset management.

Requirements

  • 4-6 years of total experience, ideally including:

3–4 years in a high-growth startup or operating role where you owned key projects end-to-end.

2–4 years at a top-tier management consulting firm (BCG, Bain, McKinsey, etc.)

  • Proven track record of leading and executing complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills — comfortable in Excel, PowerPoint, and with messy data.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity, prioritize ruthlessly, and move fast.
  • Strong business judgment and curiosity about how hardware, logistics, and software intersect.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish or Chinese a plus.
  • Based in São Paulo, with willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.
  • Strong alignment with Vammo's mission and values.

What You'll Get

  • A front-row seat at one of Latin America's most ambitious hardware and climate tech startups, backed by world-class investors.
  • A mission-driven environment where every decision contributes to decarbonizing mobility and empowering low-income workers.
  • Exposure to all areas of the business — you'll work directly with the founders and leadership team on company-defining decisions.
  • Freedom to take on as much responsibility as you can handle — and grow faster than anywhere else.
  • Competitive compensation and equity package.
  • Health insurance and benefits.
  • A collaborative, fast-paced, and purpose-driven team that loves to build real things in the real world.

Vammo is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, or any other protected factor.

title: Lower School Physical Education Teacher
description:
*Please attach your CV in English.

Primary Purpose of the Position

The Lower School Physical Education Teacher promotes the physical, social, and emotional development of students through a comprehensive, developmentally appropriate physical education program. The teacher fosters a lifelong appreciation for physical activity, healthy habits, teamwork, and personal responsibility. Through engaging instruction and a safe, inclusive environment, the Physical Education Teacher supports students in developing fundamental motor skills, physical literacy, and positive attitudes toward movement, in alignment with the school's mission and values.

Main Duties and Responsibilities

Instruction and Student Learning

  • Plan and deliver developmentally appropriate physical education lessons for lower school students.
  • Teach fundamental movement skills, coordination, balance, fi tness concepts, and age-appropriate games.
  • Promote physical literacy, cooperation, sportsmanship, and respect through structured and unstructured activities.
  • Differentiate instruction to meet diverse physical abilities, developmental stages, and learning needs of students.
  • Integrate health, wellness, and safety concepts into physical education instruction.
  • Encourage student engagement, confi dence, and enjoyment in physical activity.

Assessment and Feedback

  • Use formative and summative assessment strategies to monitor student progress in physical skills and fi tness.
  • Provide constructive, age-appropriate feedback to support student growth and self-awareness.
  • Maintain accurate records of student participation, skill development, and progress.
  • Communicate student progress and expectations with families as appropriate.
  • Learning Environment and Safety
  • Create a safe, inclusive, and positive learning environment that supports student well-being and risk-appropriate physical activity.
  • Ensure proper use, care, and supervision of facilities and equipment.
  • Follow school policies and best practices related to safety, supervision, and injury prevention.
  • Promote respect, inclusion, and positive behavior in all physical education settings.
  • Collaboration and Professional Practice
  • Collaborate with classroom teachers, specialists, and student support staff to support holistic student development.
  • Participate actively in grade-level meetings, professional development, and school-wide initiatives.
  • Support school events, athletics days, and community activities as appropriate.
  • Communicate effectively and professionally with students, parents, and colleagues.
  • Demonstrate professionalism in attendance, punctuality, conduct, and communication.

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Physical Education, Kinesiology, Exercise Science, or a related fi eld.
  • Valid teaching certifi cation/license in Physical Education (U.S. or internationally recognized equivalent).

Desired

  • Master's degree in Physical Education, Sports Science, or related discipline.
  • First Aid, CPR, and child safety certifi cation.
  • Training in physical literacy or inclusive physical education practices.

Experience

Required

  • Minimum of fi ve years of teaching experience.
  • Demonstrated experience teaching physical education to young children.

Desired

  • Experience adapting physical education for students with diverse needs.
  • Experience supporting school-wide wellness initiatives.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Required

  • Strong understanding of child development and age-appropriate physical education pedagogy.
  • Ability to design engaging, safe, and inclusive physical education lessons.
  • Effective classroom and behavior management skills in active learning environments.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with students, families, and colleagues.

Personal Attributes

  • Commitment to the school's mission, vision, and values.
  • Enthusiasm for working with young children and promoting healthy lifestyles.
  • Professionalism, reliability, and strong sense of responsibility for student safety.
  • Collaborative, fl exible, and refl ective approach to teaching

title: Estagiário Administrativo
description:
Estágio: Administração de empresas, tecnologia em gestão da qualidade, afins. (Ensino Superior).

Objetivo: No geral, o objetivo principal do estagio é proporcionar uma oportunidade de aprendizado e crescimento profissional para o estagiário, preparando-o para uma carreira voltada para administração de empresas e afins.

Ensino:

  • Assistência em Projetos: O estagiário pode ser designado para auxiliar em projetos específicos dentro do departamento de administração, como análise de dados, preparação de relatórios, pesquisa de mercado ou desenvolvimento de estratégias.
  • Suporte Administrativo: Isso pode incluir tarefas como gerenciamento de arquivos, organização de documentos, preparação de apresentações, agendamento de reuniões e atendimento telefônico.
  • Auxílio em Processos de Recursos Humanos: O estagiário pode ser envolvido em atividades relacionadas a recursos humanos, como triagem de currículos, agendamento de entrevistas, participação em processos de integração de novos funcionários ou auxílio na elaboração de políticas internas.
  • Gestão de Procedimentos Operacionais: Isso pode envolver a documentação de procedimentos operacionais, identificação de melhorias nos processos existentes e suporte na implementação de novos procedimentos.
  • Pesquisa e Análise: O estagiário pode ser responsáveis por conduzir pesquisas de mercado, coletar e analisar dados relevantes para apoiar as decisões administrativas da empresa.
  • Participação em Reuniões e Treinamentos: O estagiário pode ser convidado a participar de reuniões de equipe, sessões de treinamento ou eventos corporativos para aprender mais sobre a empresa e o campo de administração.
  • Certificação em Sistemas de Gestão: O estagiário terá aprendizado em práticas e rotinas administrativas voltadas para certificação de sistemas de gestão ISO 9001 + PBQP-H (Programa Brasileiro da Qualidade e Produtividade do Habitat).

Embora os estagiários geralmente não tenham responsabilidades tão grandes quanto os funcionários em tempo integral, eles desempenham um papel importante no apoio às operações diárias e no desenvolvimento de habilidades profissionais relevantes para a área de administração.

Qualificações:

  • Habilidades Analíticas: É importante ter habilidades analíticas para analisar processos, identificar áreas de melhoria e propor soluções eficazes para problemas de qualidade.
  • Habilidades de Comunicação e Relacionamento Interpessoal: Capacidade de comunicar claramente ideias e informações relacionadas à qualidade, bem como colaborar efetivamente com colegas de trabalho, clientes e auditores externos.
  • Conhecimento de Ferramentas de Qualidade: Familiaridade com ferramentas e técnicas de qualidade, como PDCA (Plan-Do-Check-Act), análise de causa raiz, diagrama de Ishikawa, FMEA (Análise de Modo e Efeito de Falha) e outras, pode ser um diferencial.
  • Conhecimento em Certificação: Familiaridade com certificação INMETRO e PBQP-H (Programa Brasileiro da Qualidade e Produtividade do Habitat) e outras, pode ser um diferencial.

Sobre o estágio: Estágio em conjunto com o NÚCLEO BRASILEIRO DE ESTÁGIOS - NUBE.

title: VMware Administrator (VSphere)
description:

  • Monitor and remediate security compliance results from tool like Nessus/Tenable
  • Perform VMware crash/error analysis, Root Cause Analysis, Coordinate Post Problem Analysis and Trend Analysis
  • Basic Linux administration
  • On-call support

Mandatory Skills Description:

  • Operating System Proficiency, including Linux (primarily RHEL and Rocky)
  • Server Hardware Management
  • Virtualization, especially VMware
  • Network Management, including DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP

  • Monitoring and Troubleshooting

Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • Managing backups
  • Dell Server Hardware
  • PowerShell
  • Python
  • Storage Platforms such as EMC, Netapp, Isilon, etc.
  • Storage Protocols, including iSCSI, Fibre Channel, NFS
  • Storage Virtualization
  • Storage Security, including access controls and encryption data at rest
  • Ansible

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Mainframe Storage Engineer (HOME OFFICE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Storage Engineer (IBM zOS systems) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.

Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil.

All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).

We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration, and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.

Job responsibilities:

  • Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
  • Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm, DFSMShsm, and related advanced audit and reporting tools.
  • Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.

Key skills:

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Proficiency in TSO, ISPF, and JCL.
  • Ability to write REXX and Assembler programs.
  • Experience with DFSMSrmm and/or CA-1 Tape Management System.
  • Hands-on experience with IBM tools such as:

>> IBM OMEGAMON for Storage

>> IBM Advanced Audit and Reporting for DFSMShsm

>> IBM Advanced Catalog Management (ACM)

>> IBM Advanced Allocation Management (AAM)

  • Ability to migrate tools, including the following, within mainframe systems

>> CA-1 to DFSMSrmm migration (configuration, installation, JCL code, runtime parameters).

>> CA FAVER to IBM Advanced Catalog Management migration (customized JCL creation).

>> IBM Global Resource Serialization (GRS) migration (training, PARMLIB member creation,

operational considerations).

>> CA Allocate to IBM Advanced Allocation Management migration (installation, configuration, training).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.

Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E.
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z.
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

title: Gerente de engenharia de software
description:
Título do Cargo: Gerente de Modernização e Arquiteto Líder de Soluções em IA (AI Problem-Solving Architect)

Buscamos uma Liderança Disruptiva e altamente técnica para atuar como Gerente de Modernização e Arquiteto Líder de Soluções em IA. Este profissional será o principal resolvedor de problemas técnicos de alto nível, responsável por conceber, projetar e liderar a implementação de arquiteturas de Inteligência Artificial de última geração, com foco em sistemas de multiagentes. O papel exige profundos conhecimentos em LLMs, RAG, Deep Learning e experiência prática com orquestração de agentes (ex: CrewAI, LangChain), visando a criação de soluções mais eficazes, determinísticas e com alucinação minimizada. O líder será responsável por guiar e desenvolver uma equipe de 8 profissionais de alto desempenho, garantindo a transformação e modernização contínua dos nossos sistemas e processos.

1. Liderança e Gestão de Pessoas (Liderança Disruptiva):

  • Liderar, inspirar e gerenciar uma equipe multidisciplinar de 8 profissionais (Cientistas de Dados, Engenheiros de IA/ML, etc.), promovendo uma cultura de experimentação, alta performance, agilidade e disrupção.
  • Definir prioridades estratégicas, acompanhar o progresso dos projetos e garantir a entrega de soluções de IA que geram valor de negócio mensurável.
  • Atuar como mentor técnico, estimulando o desenvolvimento contínuo da equipe nas mais recentes tecnologias de IA, Orquestração e LLMs.

2. Arquitetura e Engenharia de Soluções de IA:

  • Ser o "Arquiteto de Soluções de Problemas em AI", traduzindo desafios complexos de negócio em projetos de arquitetura de IA escaláveis, robustos e inovadores.
  • Projetar e otimizar sistemas de orquestração de Multiagentes, definindo fluxos de trabalho, comunicação (A2A - Agent-to-Agent) e protocolos de interação.
  • Desenhar e implementar arquiteturas baseadas em LLMs (Large Language Models) e sistemas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
  • Garantir a integração e modernização das soluções de IA com os sistemas legados e plataformas de nuvem (AWS, Azure, GCP).

3. Governança e Otimização de Agentes:

  • Desenvolver e aplicar metodologias e técnicas avançadas de Prompt Engineering e Context Engineering para controlar e guiar o comportamento dos agentes.
  • Implementar mecanismos de "guardrails" e estratégias de validação para diminuir a alucinação dos agentes, aumentando a eficácia, a precisão e o comportamento determinístico das soluções de IA.
  • Definir padrões de MLOps (Machine Learning Operations), governança e monitoramento para garantir a estabilidade, segurança e conformidade das soluções em produção.

4. Estratégia e Inovação em Modernização:

  • Identificar e propor oportunidades de modernização tecnológica e disrupção em processos-chave da organização através do uso estratégico da IA.
  • Conduzir a avaliação e a adoção de novas ferramentas e frameworks de IA (como CrewAI, LangChain, AutoGen, etc.) para acelerar a inovação e o desenvolvimento de produtos.

Experiência Técnica (Hard Skills):

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada no papel de Arquiteto de Soluções, Arquiteto de Sistemas Sênior e função de liderança técnica equivalente, com foco em IA/ML.
  • Conhecimento Profundo (Hands-on) em:
  • LLMs (Large Language Models) e suas arquiteturas (Transformer, etc.).
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) e otimização de bases de conhecimento para LLMs.
  • Orquestração de Multiagentes: Experiência prática com frameworks como CrewAI, LangChain ou ferramentas similares.
  • Deep Learning e frameworks como PyTorch ou TensorFlow.
  • Arquitetura de dados para IA (Vector Databases, Feature Stores, Data Pipelines).
  • MLOps e CI/CD para modelos e sistemas de IA.
  • Experiência comprovada em técnicas de mitigação de bias e alucinação em LLMs, visando a deterministicidade.

Liderança e Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills):

  • Liderança Disruptiva: Capacidade de desafiar o status quo, promover a mudança, tomar decisões ousadas e construir uma visão tecnológica ambiciosa.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação para interagir com a equipe, stakeholders técnicos e executivos.
  • Visão Estratégica e Habilidade de Solução de Problemas (AI Problem-Solving Architect).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em modernização de sistemas legados utilizando IA.
  • Publicações, contribuições ou participação ativa em comunidades de IA Generativa e Sistemas Multiagentes.
  • Certificações em Arquitetura de Nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP) focadas em IA/ML.

  • Contribuir para a atualização de políticas, normas e procedimentos de Finanças.
  • Propor otimizações e controles automatizados (ERP/BI/RPA) para reduzir riscos e aumentar eficiência.

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)

Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.

What You'll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems

Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Senior Full Stack Software Engineer

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join a high-impact engineering team working on a large-scale, enterprise-grade, multi-tenant web platform.

In this role, you will build and maintain a sophisticated web application using modern technologies, contributing to a codebase that prioritizes performance, scalability, code quality, and exceptional user experience.

Technical Stack - Core Technologies

  • Frontend: React 18, Next.js 14 (Pages Router), TypeScript
  • Styling: Linaria (CSS-in-JS)
  • State Management: React Context API
  • Backend/API: Next.js API Routes, Node.js
  • Headless CMS: Contentstack
  • Testing: Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress (E2E)
  • Build Tools: Webpack 5, Babel, Yarn 4 (Workspaces)

Infrastructure & DevOps

  • Cloud: AWS (EKS, ECR, Route53, ALB)
  • Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions
  • Monitoring: Elastic APM
  • Caching: Redis
  • Analytics: mParticle, Adobe Target

Key Responsibilities - Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance, scalable web applications using React, TypeScript, and Next.js
  • Build and maintain reusable, well-typed component libraries with comprehensive test coverage
  • Integrate and manage content delivery workflows using a headless CMS

Code Quality & Best Practices

  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following established standards (strict TypeScript, ESLint, Stylelint)
  • Implement unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Participate in code reviews and provide constructive, high-quality feedback
  • Follow accessibility standards and best practices in semantic HTML

Collaboration

  • Work closely with designers, product managers, and engineering teams
  • Mentor junior engineers and lead technical knowledge-sharing initiatives
  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and technical design discussions
  • Maintain technical documentation and contribute to architectural decision records

Required Qualifications - Experience

  • 3–5 years of professional software development experience
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with React and TypeScript
  • 2+ years working with Next.js or similar SSR frameworks
  • Strong experience with modern JavaScript (ES6+) and Node.js
  • Experience with CSS-in-JS solutions (Linaria, Styled Components, or similar)
  • Proven experience building and maintaining large-scale web applications
  • Experience working with headless CMS platforms

Technical Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in TypeScript with strict typing
  • Strong understanding of React hooks, Context API, and component lifecycle
  • Experience with modern build tools such as Webpack and Babel
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud services
  • Proficiency with Git and command-line workflows
  • Strong testing mindset with experience in Jest, React Testing Library, and E2E testing

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical challenges
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain complex technical concepts
  • High attention to detail and strong commitment to code quality
  • Ability to balance technical debt and feature delivery in a fast-paced environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience in regulated or enterprise-scale platforms

title: HRBP Lead, Latam
description:
As the HRBP Latam Lead, you will be a strategic partner and a key driver of organizational success across our most vibrant markets in Latin America: Brazil and Mexico. This is a high-impact role where you will balance regional nuances with global standards, ensuring our talent strategy aligns with Ant International's vision of building a more inclusive and sustainable future.

Reporting directly to our global leadership outside the region, you will act as the bridge between local operations and international strategy. You will lead HR initiatives that foster innovation, support rapid growth, and nurture a world-class employee experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Partnership: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership in Brazil and Mexico, providing insights on organizational design, talent strategy, and workforce planning.
  • Regional Oversight: Lead HR operations for both Brazil and Mexico, ensuring alignment in culture while respecting local labor laws, market practices, and compliance requirements.
  • Talent Management: Drive end-to-end talent cycles, including performance management, succession planning, and leadership development to build a robust pipeline for the region.
  • Cultural Integration: Facilitate a seamless connection between Latam teams and global headquarters, fostering an inclusive environment that celebrates diversity and global collaboration.
  • Employee Engagement: Implement initiatives that enhance the employee value proposition (EVP) and maintain high levels of engagement and retention.
  • Change Management: Lead the organization through periods of rapid growth and transformation, ensuring smooth transitions and clear communication across all levels.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: Significant experience as an HR Business Partner, with a proven track record of supporting multi-country operations (ideally Brazil and Mexico).
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field. An MBA or specialized HR certification is highly preferred.
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English is mandatory, as you will report to global leadership and collaborate with international stakeholders daily.
  • Market Knowledge: Deep understanding of the Brazilian labor market and regulatory environment. Familiarity with the Mexican market is a strong advantage.
  • Communication: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence and navigate a complex, fast-paced global matrix organization.

Preferred Qualifications (The "Plus" Factors)

  • Multilingualism: Proficiency in Spanish or Mandarin Chinese is a significant advantage.
  • International Exposure: Previous experience working with or managing stakeholders in the United States or other global tech hubs.
  • Leadership: Demonstrated experience in people management and leading HR teams.
  • Industry Background: Experience in the FinTech, Technology, or Financial Services sectors.

title: Operador(a) de máquinas
description:

Furukawa Electric LatAm, Furukawa Electric Fiber & Cable e OFS agora são Lightera

Lightera é mais do que um nome, é um compromisso com a criação de conexões mais brilhantes que moldam o futuro.

O nome Lightera combina as palavras light (luz) e era, simbolizando um novo capítulo iluminado pelo poder transformador da luz. Isso reflete nossas raízes na tecnologia de fibra óptica e nossa visão de liderar o caminho para um futuro mais brilhante e mais conectado.

A Lightera está com vagas abertas para Operador(a) de Máquinas e busca pessoas comprometidas, que gostem de desafios e desejem evoluir junto com a empresa.

Aqui, você fará parte de um ambiente industrial moderno, com foco em segurança, qualidade, melhoria contínua e desenvolvimento de pessoas.

Área: Fábrica de Cabos

Local: Cidade Industrial de Curitiba

Modelo de trabalho: Fixo

Horário: Turnos e/ou escala 3x3

REQUISITOS:

  • Ensino Médio completo;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em turnos e/ou escala 3x3;
  • Residir em Curitiba ou Região Metropolitana, com fácil acesso à região da CIC;

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência anterior como Operador(a) de Máquinas em ambiente industrial;
  • Curso de Mecânica Básica Industrial, Processos Industriais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de melhoria contínua, como 5S, Kaizen, TPM ou Lean Manufacturing;
  • Experiência com controle de qualidade visual e/ou dimensional;
  • Vivência em empresas dos segmentos metalúrgico, elétrico ou de cabos/fibras ópticas.

ATRIBUIÇÕES:

  • Operar máquinas fixas nos processos de trefilação, binagem, reunião, extrusão de isolamento, capa e tubo, pintura de fibras e fracionamento de cabos ópticos e eletrônicos, conforme os padrões operacionais;
  • Realizar inspeções durante o processo produtivo, assegurando a conformidade dos produtos com as normas internas de qualidade;

Faça parte de nossa missão de moldar o futuro da conectividade.

title: Banco de Talentos: Consultor de Implementação ITSM
description:
Sobre a Bravo Solutions

A Bravo Solutions é uma empresa inovadora especializada em soluções de software que visam transformar a experiência do cliente. Nossa missão é fornecer ferramentas tecnológicas de ponta que permitam aos nossos clientes otimizar seus processos e alcançar resultados excepcionais.

Atenção ao Perfil: Esta é uma posição de cunho técnico e operacional. Buscamos profissionais que gostam de configurar sistemas, desenhar fluxos lógicos e resolver problemas de software. Se o seu perfil é focado exclusivamente em Customer Success (CS) comercial, gestão de contas ou métricas de retenção, esta vaga não se adequa às suas atividades diárias.
O que você fará por aqui:

Buscamos um Consultor versátil para atuar em duas frentes principais:

  • Implementação e Projetos: Analisar os processos do cliente e realizar a configuração técnica (parametrização) das ferramentas Freshworks e similares. Criar fluxos de automação, níveis de serviço (SLAs) e portais de autoatendimento.
  • Consultoria de Suporte: Atendimento especializado de tickets de média e alta complexidade, realizando diagnósticos de causa raiz e ajustes de configuração para garantir o sucesso da solução.
  • Treinamento e Capacitação: Conduzir sessões consultivas para ensinar usuários e administradores a utilizarem as funcionalidades técnicas configuradas.
O que buscamos (Requisitos):
  • Experiência Técnica: Vivência prévia com implementação de sistemas, suporte técnico especializado ou consultoria de software SaaS.
  • Lógica de Sistemas: Capacidade de traduzir processos de negócio em regras lógicas dentro do software (Ex: "If/Then" logic, automações e triggers).
  • Domínio de Ferramentas: Familiaridade com softwares de ITSM, Helpdesk ou CRM (Freshservice, Freshdesk, Jira Service Management ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em Processos: Fundamentos de ITIL, Gestão de Serviços ou Governança de TI.
  • Formação: Graduação concluída ou cursando em TI, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia, Administração de Sistemas ou áreas correlatas.
Diferenciais:
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Conhecimento em Scrum ou Kanban para organização de fluxos de trabalho e entregas.
  • Idioma: Inglês intermediário para leitura de documentações e interação com parceiros globais.
Informações Gerais:
  • Modelo de Contratação: Possibilidade de contratação via CLT ou PJ.
Por que entrar para o nosso banco?

Ao se cadastrar, seu perfil será avaliado para futuras oportunidades em nossos times de Serviços Profissionais (Projetos) ou Suporte Especializado, permitindo que você atue em um ambiente de tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

title: Risk & Response Manager [Trust and Safety]

title: Analista de Gestão de Fornecedores Sênior
description:
Missão: Ser responsável por estruturar, sustentar e evoluir o modelo de SRM (Supplier Relationship Management) da companhia, garantindo práticas consistentes de segmentação, performance, risco e desenvolvimento de fornecedores. title: Mobile Developer (iOS)
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.

Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to design, build, and ship high-quality mobile applications, with a strong focus on iOS-first development. This role is ideal for someone who has spent years building production iOS apps, thrives in early-stage or fast-moving environments, and enjoys owning features end to end—from architecture decisions to App Store delivery.

You will work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver scalable, high-performance mobile experiences while maintaining clean, testable, and well-structured code.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain advanced iOS applications, with Android considered a plus.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements, design solutions, and ship new features.
  • Own performance, quality, and responsiveness across the mobile app.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, crashes, and complex bugs.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code, contributing to automation and CI/CD workflows.
  • Integrate mobile applications with RESTful or GraphQL APIs and third-party libraries.
  • Make informed architectural decisions suitable for scalable MVPs and growing products.
  • Stay current with iOS best practices, platform updates, and modern mobile development trends.
  • Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including planning, reviews, and technical discussions.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8–10 years of professional experience in mobile development, with a strong focus on iOS.
  • Proven track record of shipping at least one high-quality iOS app to the App Store.
  • Deep proficiency in Swift and SwiftUI (or UIKit, depending on project needs).
  • Solid understanding of the full mobile application development lifecycle, from concept to release and iteration.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile UI/UX patterns and Apple platform guidelines.
  • Hands-on experience integrating mobile apps with RESTful or GraphQL APIs.
  • Proficiency with Git, Xcode, and modern dependency managers such as Swift Package Manager.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership mindset.
  • Advanced written and spoken English for collaboration in a distributed, international team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with UIKit, Combine, Async/Await, CoreData, or Realm.
  • Experience implementing or customizing video playback features using AVPlayer / AVKit (or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with Android development (Kotlin/Java) is a plus.
  • Experience setting up or working with CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
  • Experience using mobile performance and profiling tools (Instruments, Crashlytics, etc.).
  • Background working in early-stage startups or building MVPs from scratch.

Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support

title: Data Analytics Intern - Charging Network
description:
About Vammo

At Vammo, we're leading the charge toward a cleaner, more sustainable future for urban mobility in Latin America. As the region's largest electric two-wheeler fleet operator, we're transforming how cities move with our innovative battery-swapping network and all-electric motorcycle rental platform.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: eliminate the barriers to electric adoption and create a world where the energy powering your ride today fuels someone else's tomorrow.

Backed by over $40 million from top-tier investors like Monashees, Construct Capital, Maniv Mobility, and 2150, Vammo is a fast-growing, mission-driven company redefining transportation in one of the most dynamic markets on the planet. Our team is built on talent from world-class companies like Tesla, Uber, Rappi, and Loggi, united by a shared passion for innovation and impact. If you're ready to help shape the future of electric mobility and be part of a movement that truly matters, we'd love to hear from you.

Role Description

As a Data Analytics Intern - Charging Network, you will be at the heart of our charging network intelligence. You will sit at the intersection of infrastructure, operations and product, turning complex IoT and geospatial data into clear insights that keep our battery-swapping network running at peak performance. You will be working alongside an experienced Data Science & Analytics team, supporting a development-focused internship experience with real-world impact.

Your work will directly power the growth of our infrastructure, ensuring battery availability and optimizing the health of our most critical assets. You will dive deep into:

  • Network Health Metrics: Monitor state-of-charge (SoC), energy efficiency, and charge/discharge cycles to ensure reliability and support efficient deployment of resources to manage network health.
  • Operational Optimization: Combine demand patterns with geospatial data to solve the complex puzzle of where and when to expand our network.
  • IoT & Telemetry Data: Analyze millions of real-time data points from our swapping stations, batteries and vehicles.

You will have the opportunity to combine these rich data sources to solve some of the most complex and interesting challenges in electric mobility.

Here are the types of things you'll be doing

  • Data-Driven Decision Support: Collaborate directly with our Data Science & Analytics team to tackle complex, cross-functional problems — from predictive maintenance to network expansion strategy — bringing data-driven recommendations that shape real business decisions.
  • Network Health & Reliability: Develop dashboards to monitor the real-time status of swapping stations, identifying "offline" risks before they impact the user.
  • Demand & Supply Forecasting: Help build models to predict battery demand at specific stations, ensuring riders never arrive at an empty hub.
  • Asset Longevity Analysis: Use charging data to identify patterns that affect battery life, informing our long-term maintenance and replacement strategies.
  • Expansion Intelligence: Conduct geospatial analysis to identify high-potential locations for new battery stations based on rider density and traffic flow.
  • Resource Deployment: Support development of analysis to inform where and when we should deploy our field resources to ensure a healthy network for our users.
  • Charging Strategy Optimization: Analyze energy costs and grid constraints to help refine our battery charging schedules.
  • Insight and Findings Communication: Build dashboards and clearly present your findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, directly influencing decision-making.

Who we are looking for

The ideal candidate is a curious problem-solver who isn't afraid to get their hands dirt with messy, real-world data.

Required qualifications:

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Familiarity with SQL and relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, BigQuery) or data analysis tools in Python or another language.
  • Strong knowledge of Python or R, especially with data analysis and modeling libraries.
  • Experience with data visualization tools or libraries.
  • Strong grasp of statistics, and a desire to learn how to build predictive models.
  • A proactive "builder" mentality - you take pride in seeing your analysis lead to real-world changes.
  • Solid communication skills - you can explain the "why" behind the numbers clearly and concisely.

Nice to have qualifications

  • Prior experience in a startup or a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience handling medium or large datasets.
  • Knowledge of machine learning concepts and/or automation tools.
  • Interest in geospatial analysis or GIS tools.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning.   • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.

Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.

Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect

Role: Senior Software Engineer

Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.

About the role

Own and evolve critical payments/back-office services end-to-end: design, build, ship, and operate API-first Python systems that automate disputes/chargebacks and related workflows. You'll partner directly with clients and internal teams to translate business rules into reliable integrations, services, and data models— leveraging Linux, with a pragmatic DevOps mindset.

Responsibilities

  • Lead project execution: technical design, implementation plans, code reviews, and delivery coordination.
  • Build and operate REST APIs in Python (versioning, idempotency, auth, webhooks, integrations).
  • Own API integrations with external partners/processors: onboarding, validation, retries, error handling, and SLAs.
  • Implement complex payments/chargeback business logic from requirements and client workflows; ensure correctness and auditability.
  • Model API/domain data with strong data-structure fundamentals (schemas, invariants, normalization/denormalization tradeoffs).
  • Develop and maintain client-facing device intelligence instrumentation in JavaScript where needed (collection, privacy controls, performance).
  • Meet and maintain contact directly with clients.
  • Operate services on Linux: deployments, debugging, performance tuning, incident response, and reliability improvements.
  • Contribute to DevOps practices: CI/CD pipelines, safe rollouts, observability (logs/metrics/traces), and operational automation.

Required

  • Expert Python backend engineer (3.12+ preferred): strong typing, testing, concurrency fundamentals, and performance debugging.
  • Proven REST API development experience (design + production operations), including integrations and webhooks.
  • Strong data structures and API data modeling skills (clear contracts, backward compatibility, validations).
  • Experience implementing business logic for payments/fintech workflows, especially disputes/chargebacks and reconciliations.
  • Comfortable on Linux servers with a DevOps mindset (deploy/run/debug production services; automate operational work).
  • Client-facing technical communication: can interface with external stakeholders to clarify requirements, diagnose issues, and drive resolutions.
  • Ownership mentality and interest in leadership: drive the full lifecycle from discovery → design → build → operate.

Nice to have

  • JavaScript experience beyond basics (instrumentation, performance, privacy-aware collection) for client integrations.
  • Containerization/orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), IaC (Terraform), and cloud-native operations on Amazon Web Services.
  • Event-driven/workflow systems (SQS/Kafka/Kinesis; Airflow/Prefect/Dagster).
  • Security/compliance exposure (PCI, SOC 2) and observability tooling at scale.

How to apply

Send an English resume and links to relevant work (repos, API docs, architectural notes, or write-ups) showing:

  • Python backend API development + real-world API integrations
  • Payments/disputes/chargebacks or similarly complex workflow automation
  • Linux/DevOps experience running production services
  • Any JavaScript instrumentation work and client-facing delivery experience

title: Finance Manager - Legal Entity (Brazil)
description:
Role objective

As a member of the Finance team, the Finance Manager of the legal entity plays a key role in ensuring the financial integrity, transparency and performance of the subsidiary. He/She acts as the local finance business partner to the management team, ensuring accurate financial reporting, cost control, and alignment with the group's strategic and financial objectives.

The role encompasses full responsibility for accounting, controlling and financial planning activities at the subsidiary level – ensuring compliance with local regulations while adhering to group policies and standards. The ideal candidate combines a strong technical finance background with entrepreneurial spirit, operational understanding and a hands-on approach to support the entity's sustainable growth and profitability.

Reporting lines and interactions

This position reports directly to the Group CFO and functionally collaborates with the Finance Manager in Switzerland. The Finance Manager also works closely with the local Management team and collaborates with the HR Lead in Switzerland.

Key responsibilities

  • Oversee all financial operations of the legal entity incl. maintain the day-to-day accounting of the Subsidiary (invoicing, bank reconciliation, GL entries, provisions)
  • Ensure timely and accurate month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closings in line with group deadlines and standards
  • Prepare monthly management reports, variance analyses, and performance dashboards for both local management and Group Finance
  • Develop, monitor, and analyze annual budgets and rolling forecasts, identifying risks and opportunities
  • Control and analyze production, sales, and overhead costs; ensure proper allocation and transparency of cost structures
  • Manage cash flow, working capital, and intercompany transactions, ensuring liquidity and compliance with group treasury policies
  • Support audits (internal and external) and ensure adherence to internal control standards and regulatory requirements
  • Coordinate local tax filings and liaise with external auditors, tax advisors, and authorities as required
  • Act as a financial business partner to the local management team, providing decision support and strategic financial insights
  • Drive process improvement and digitalization initiatives within Finance (ERP enhancements, automation, reporting tools)
  • Ensure alignment of local finance processes with global policies, and actively contribute to group-wide finance projects

Additional Responsibilities (HR & Office Management)

  • Support in HR administration, including employee onboarding/offboarding, contract preparation and maintenance of personnel records. Cooperate with global HR.
  • Manage payroll processing and ensure compliance with local labor laws, social security obligations and internal controls.
  • Coordinate office management activities, including facilities coordination, vendor management and ensuring smooth daily office operation.

Qualifications

  • University degree in Finance, Business Administration, or Industrial Engineering (Bachelor's or Master's level).

Experience / Skills

  • Minimum of 5 years' experience in controlling, preferably in a technology-driven company
  • Strong understanding of accounting, controlling, budgeting and financial reporting process
  • Experience with ERP systems (Odoo experience is a plus) and excellent command of Excel
  • Knowledge of local statutory accounting and tax requirements
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail
  • Knowledge of English and French is an advantage
  • Proactive, structured and capable of working independently as well as collaboratively with technical teams
  • Hands-on, proactive and solution-oriented with a strong sense of ownership
  • Strong communication skills, able to translate complex financial data into actionable insights

title: Power BI Analyst (Projeto Temporário)
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Você atuará em um projeto de uma multinacional global de grande porte, referência nos segmentos de bens de consumo duráveis e tecnologia.

A posição faz parte de um projeto temporário e estratégico, conduzido pelo CIO Office, com foco na criação de uma visão unificada, automatizada e confiável de performance de TI. O objetivo é apoiar decisões executivas em nível global e fortalecer a atuação de TI como uma área orientada a resultados e geração de valor para o negócio.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

O que você precisa ter

  • Forte conhecimento em modelagem semântica e DAX
  • Experiência com integração de múltiplas fontes de dados corporativas

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

Our team is distinguished by deep expertise in front-office and risk technology solutions, empowering top-tier financial institutions to optimize their trading and risk management capabilities.

At Phi Partners, we are committed to a collaborative, high-performance culture where professionals work together to deliver complex front-office solutions to elite clients. We specialize in the end-to-end implementation of front-office and risk platforms, from initial requirements gathering to post-go-live support, ensuring that our clients are fully supported throughout the platform lifecycle. Join us as we build the next-generation eTrading team, an ambitious, fast-growing group delivering world-class, complex, and genuinely exciting projects to major financial institutions around the globe. We're in a pivotal expansion phase, working with leading-edge technologies and giving you the chance to shape our strategy, influence key architectural decisions, and deploy solutions that truly impact global Capital Markets. This is a rare opportunity to be part of a world-leading Capital Markets Technology Consultancy while working alongside one of the strongest banking organizations in the industry.

description:
No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC (Forest Stewardship Council) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

  • Realizar gestão de custos e gestão das operações considerando maquinas, caminhões, implementos e veículos da frota.
